comment: The panel groups the four state controls in columns lettered REC, CLR, SWP and SEL, each with its override jack at the top, a three-way clock switch marked 1 and 2, and a button; FEED and SMTH letter the two small knobs and the two buffer direction switches are marked with arrows. Index order is not panel order on the inputs: left to right the override jacks are input 2 (record), 3 (clear), 4 (swap) and 1 (select). The record and select jacks are combined with their buttons by exclusive or, so a button pressed while a gate is high turns the function off. The sync switch is configured with a default of 9 on a control whose range is 0 to 1 (src/ElasticTwins.cpp:98), so a fresh module comes up with the clocks locked. src/ElasticTwins.cpp:265-266 reads channel index 1 for the two lamps, which is never written on a mono patch.
